dialogues.jp: コンコン
dialogues.en: Knock, knock.
dialogues.text: Knock, knock.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「兄さん、ちょっといい？」
dialogues.en: "Niisan, can I come in for little bit?"
dialogues.text: "Niisan, can I come in for little bit?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「なんだ？」
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.jp:
部屋で雑誌を読みながらマッタリしているとこ
ろに、音夢がやってくる。
dialogues.en:
I was looking at the magazine and relaxing in my room when
Nemu came in.
dialogues.text:
I was looking at the magazine and relaxing in my room when
Nemu came in.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「ちょっと頼みたいことがあるんですけど」
dialogues.en: "I wanted to ask you for a favor."
dialogues.text: "I wanted to ask you for a favor."

dialogues.jp:
やけに控えめな言いように、俺の頭で警報が鳴
る。
dialogues.en: The alarm went on in my head as she seemed to be so polite.
dialogues.text: The alarm went on in my head as she seemed to be so polite.

dialogues.jp: 「かったるいことじゃなければな」
dialogues.en: "If it's not a pain."
dialogues.text: "If it's not a pain."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「それは保証しかねますけど……」
dialogues.en: "Well, I can't guarantee that......"
dialogues.text: "Well, I can't guarantee that......"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「ちょっと、机を動かして欲しいんだけど」
dialogues.en: "Can you help me move my desk?"
dialogues.text: "Can you help me move my desk?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「かったるいな」
dialogues.en: "What a pain."
dialogues.text: "What a pain."

dialogues.jp: 一言で片付ける。
dialogues.en: That was the end of it.
dialogues.text: That was the end of it.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「そんなこと言わないで。ね、兄さん」
dialogues.en: "Don't say that, niisan."
dialogues.text: "Don't say that, niisan."

dialogues.jp:
計算し尽くされた甘える声。聞く者すべてを従
いたくさせるその声は、俺にも例外ではなかっ
た。
dialogues.en:
It was a calculated sweet voice which has the power to make
everyone obey her, and I was no exception.
dialogues.text:
It was a calculated sweet voice which has the power to make
everyone obey her, and I was no exception.

dialogues.jp: 「…………しょうがないな」
文句をたれつつ、のそりと立ち上がる。
dialogues.en: I slowly stood up while complaining.
dialogues.text: I slowly stood up while complaining.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「ありがと」
dialogues.en: "Thank you."
dialogues.text: "Thank you."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「で、どこに動かすんだ？」
dialogues.en: "So where should I move it to?"
dialogues.text: "So where should I move it to?"

dialogues.jp: 音夢の重たそうな机を眺めながら｛たず／訊｝ねる。
dialogues.en: I asked Nemu, looking at her desk which looked heavy.
dialogues.text: I asked Nemu, looking at her desk which looked heavy.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「ううん。動かすというか、ちょっとズラすだ
　けでいいの」
dialogues.en: "No, you don't have to move it, just slide it a little."
dialogues.text: "No, you don't have to move it, just slide it a little."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「？　部屋の模様替えをするんじゃないのか？」
dialogues.en: "? Aren't you going to move your furniture around?"
dialogues.text: "? Aren't you going to move your furniture around?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「ちがうちがう。ちょっと、机の後ろに物が落
　ちちゃったから、取りたいだけなの」
dialogues.en:
"No, no. I dropped something behind the desk, and I only
want to get it."
dialogues.text:
"No, no. I dropped something behind the desk, and I only
want to get it."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「なんだ」
それなら、そんなに疲れなくてすみそうだ。
dialogues.en: It shouldn't make me tired.
dialogues.text: It shouldn't make me tired.

dialogues.jp: 「じゃあ、とっとと始めるか」
dialogues.en: "Okay then, let's get it over with."
dialogues.text: "Okay then, let's get it over with."

dialogues.jp: 机の端に手をかけ、腕にぐっと力を込める。
dialogues.en: I gripped on the edge of the desk and pulled it hard.
dialogues.text: I gripped on the edge of the desk and pulled it hard.

dialogues.jp: （意外と重たいな……）
dialogues.en: {This is heavier than I thought......}
dialogues.text: {This is heavier than I thought......}

dialogues.jp: 中に何がつまってるんだ？
dialogues.en: What is in here?
dialogues.text: What is in here?

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「引きずらないようにね」
dialogues.en: "Don't drag it, okay?"
dialogues.text: "Don't drag it, okay?"

dialogues.jp: お前も手伝え。
dialogues.en: Why don't you help.
dialogues.text: Why don't you help.

dialogues.jp: 「ふんっ！」
dialogues.en: "Huh!"
dialogues.text: "Huh!"

dialogues.jp:
息を吐き出し、腕に力を込める。机の片側が｛わず／僅｝
かに持ち上がる。そのまま横に１歩進み床にそっ
と置く。
dialogues.en:
I breathed out, gripped it hard, and one side of the desk
was lifted. I moved one step to the side and put it back on
the floor.
dialogues.text:
I breathed out, gripped it hard, and one side of the desk
was lifted. I moved one step to the side and put it back on
the floor.

dialogues.jp: 机と壁の間に、腕１本が入り込める隙間があく。
dialogues.en: I made a small space between the wall and the desk.
dialogues.text: I made a small space between the wall and the desk.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「ありがとう、兄さん」
dialogues.en: "Thank you, niisan!"
dialogues.text: "Thank you, niisan!"

dialogues.jp: 音夢が四つん這いになり、隙間に腕を突っ込む。
dialogues.en:
Nemu bent down on her hands and knees, and stuck her arm
into the small space.
dialogues.text:
Nemu bent down on her hands and knees, and stuck her arm
into the small space.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「うーんと……」
dialogues.en: "Let's see......"
dialogues.text: "Let's see......"

dialogues.jp: 手に何かを掴み音夢が立ち上がる。
dialogues.en: Nemu stood up with something in her hand.
dialogues.text: Nemu stood up with something in her hand.

dialogues.jp: 「もういいのか？」
dialogues.en: "Are you done?"
dialogues.text: "Are you done?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「うん」
dialogues.en: "Yeah."
dialogues.text: "Yeah."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「じゃあ元に戻すぞ」
dialogues.en: "Then I'll put it back."
dialogues.text: "Then I'll put it back."

dialogues.jp:
もう一度、机の端を持ち、机と壁の隙間を埋め
る。
dialogues.en:
I grabbed the edge of the desk once again and pushed it
back.
dialogues.text:
I grabbed the edge of the desk once again and pushed it
back.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「ごくろうさま」
dialogues.en: "Thank you."
dialogues.text: "Thank you."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「もう落とすなよ」
dialogues.en: "Don't drop it again."
dialogues.text: "Don't drop it again."

dialogues.jp:
壁との隙間はほとんどなくしておいたから、た
ぶん大丈夫だろうが、一応注意して音夢の部屋
をでる。
dialogues.en:
I pushed the desk against the wall as close as possible, so
I'm sure it won't happen again, but I made sure with her and
left her room.
dialogues.text:
I pushed the desk against the wall as close as possible, so
I'm sure it won't happen again, but I made sure with her and
left her room.

dialogues.jp: さてと……。
dialogues.en: Well, well......
dialogues.text: Well, well......

dialogues.jp: （雑誌の続きでも読むか）
dialogues.en: (Should I go back to my magazine?)
dialogues.text: (Should I go back to my magazine?)

dialogues.jp: ◆机の隙間◆
dialogues.en: ◆A gap between the wall and the desk◆
dialogues.text: ◆A gap between the wall and the desk◆

dialogues.jp:
机の後ろに何か物を落としたとかで、音夢に机
の移動を頼まれてしまう。
dialogues.en:
Nemu asked me to move her desk because she dropped something
behind the desk.
dialogues.text:
Nemu asked me to move her desk because she dropped something
behind the desk.

dialogues.jp:
かったるいながらも、音夢の笑顔の前に屈して
しまった俺は、音夢の部屋へ。
dialogues.en:
I thought it was too much pain, but I couldn't resist her
smile, so I went to her room.
dialogues.text:
I thought it was too much pain, but I couldn't resist her
smile, so I went to her room.

dialogues.jp:
簡単に作業を済ませ、音夢に注意したあと部屋
に戻る。まあ、隙間をなくしたから、これから
は大丈夫だろう。
dialogues.en:
I moved the desk easily, and told Nemu not to do it again
and went back to my room. I pushed the desk as close to the
wall as possible, so it should never happen again.
dialogues.text:
I moved the desk easily, and told Nemu not to do it again
and went back to my room. I pushed the desk as close to the
wall as possible, so it should never happen again.
